inferenceServers.title: Inference servers
inferenceServers.description: Configure where TTS generations and model downloads run. Multiple servers act as failover; the highest-priority online server is used.

addDialog.title: Add an inference server
addDialog.description: Pick where the server will run. Copy what appears below: the server registers itself here when it starts, nothing to paste back.

hints.linux: Run on Ubuntu or Debian as root or with sudo. The script installs Docker and the NVIDIA toolkit if needed, starts the server and reports the registration.
hints.docker: Replace <this-machine> with the address Sirene can reach. Docker Desktop on macOS or Windows works too, CPU only.
hints.compose: Save as docker-compose.yml, replace <this-machine> with the address Sirene can reach, then run docker compose up -d.
hints.railway: Click Deploy on Railway and paste these two values when Railway asks for them. Image, volume, port and auth token are preconfigured in the template.
hints.runpod: Create a GPU pod with {{image}}, expose HTTP port 8000, set these variables and attach a network volume at /app/data. RunPod provides the public URL.

addDialog.tokenHint: The registration token is valid for one hour and only allows adding a server. The worker keeps the generated auth token for itself.
addDialog.tokenFailed: Could not create a registration token
addDialog.manualHint: For a worker that is already running: paste its URL and the token it was started with.
addDialog.waiting: Waiting for the server: it shows up here on its own once it has started.

inferenceServers.syncPolicyHint: Which catalog models get installed here without asking. CPU models are the ones that run without a GPU; GPU models need one.
